[[File:Writings_of_Jadek-To.png|thumb|right|The Writings of Jadek-To]]
{{Quote|Heed the words of Jedek-To. You will not like them. I do not like them. The last Gormak must not die. There was no discussion. The interpretation was clear. If every Gormak dies, every Voss dies. This is true. Wage war but do not win. Survive. For total victory is death.|Writings of Jedek-To|<ref name="Imp March of Time">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|March of Time|Voss}}</ref>}}
The '''Writings of Jedek-To''' were composed by a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] named [[Jadek-To]] many years before his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the galactic society. The writings were etched on a pillar erected outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]]. A traveling hero recorded the writings and gave them to [[Ker-Na]].
